raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

AITER and TileLang have different sparse-prefill crossover points. This ports our versioned GLM-5.3-MXFP4 routing policies to current upstream without changing default backend selection.

## Modifications

- Add `--dsa-prefill-policy` with explicit MI350X TP4 BF16/FP8 profiles.
- Select from host metadata once per eager sparse-prefill batch; store the decision for all layers. Keep decode, speculative, mixed and dense dispatch unchanged.
- Enforce architecture, dtype, topology and shape restrictions, with bounded TileLang fallback. Do not change KV layout/capacity, top-k or sampling.
- Add registered CPU coverage and usage documentation. No experimental force/target-verify modes or unrelated production patches.

## Accuracy Tests

22 new CPU tests pass; 25 existing namespace/runtime-context/read-ratchet tests also pass. Local tests ran in a GPU-isolated ROCm image with the HIP/device and optional AITER import boundaries switched to CPU-only behavior. These results validate routing/configuration, not GPU attention numerics or model accuracy.

AMD TP4 model replay and graph smoke on this port are still pending.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The thresholds are carried over from earlier GLM-5.3-MXFP4 measurements, not retuned on this upstream revision. No new speedup claim. Pending validation compares prefill, cached-tail and decode/verify forward latency on the same GPU lane with unchanged KV dtype/pool budget and sampling configuration.

## Known dependency

The FP8 profile does not repair AITER softmax-numerator underflow: https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/5535. It remains unqualified for promotion until the AITER variant selected by this stack passes numerical and model-level checks. No patched `.co` is bundled.

## Checklist

- [x] Focused Ruff/isort/codespell and registered-test checks.
- [x] CPU unit/regression coverage.
- [x] Documentation build and link validation.
- [ ] AMD model accuracy and forward-latency benchmarks.
- [ ] FP8 AITER numerical qualification.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Host-only, opt-in policies for ROCm sparse MLA prefill.
+
+The profiles were fitted on GLM-5.3-MXFP4 with MI350X TP4. They select an
+implementation; they neither change the KV layout nor repair its numerics.
+In particular, the FP8 profile needs a separately validated AITER kernel
+(see ROCm/aiter#5535). It must not be treated as an FP8 correctness guarantee.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Literal
+
+RocmDSAPrefillBackend = Literal["aiter", "tilelang"]
+ROCM_DSA_PREFILL_POLICIES = (
+    "glm53-mi350x-tp4-bf16-v1",
+    "glm53-mi350x-tp4-fp8-v1",
+)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DSAPrefillShape:
+    """Realized query rows and total KV length, not requested concurrency.
+
+    ``total_q_tokens`` excludes cached prefix tokens. ``max_kv_len`` includes
+    the prefix and this extend. All values must already reside on the host.
+    """
+
+    total_q_tokens: int
+    max_q_len: int
+    batch_size: int
+    max_kv_len: int
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        for name in ("total_q_tokens", "max_q_len", "batch_size", "max_kv_len"):
+            if getattr(self, name) < 0:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-negative")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RocmDSAPrefillPolicy:
+    """Bounded offline policy; unsupported batch shapes use TileLang.
+
+    The 32K fresh-row ceiling is a workspace-safety bound, not a measured
+    performance crossover. No policy is enabled or inferred automatically.
+    """
+
+    policy_id: str
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.policy_id not in ROCM_DSA_PREFILL_POLICIES:
+            raise ValueError(f"Unknown ROCm DSA prefill policy: {self.policy_id!r}")
+
+    @property
+    def kv_dtype(self) -> str:
+        return "float8_e4m3fn" if self.policy_id.endswith("fp8-v1") else "bfloat16"
+
+    def validate_runtime(
+        self,
+        *,
+        architecture: str,
+        attn_tp_size: int,
+        attn_cp_size: int,
+        dcp_size: int,
+        kv_dtype: str,
+        prefill_backend: str,
+        prefill_graph_enabled: bool,
+        deterministic: bool,
+        index_topk: int,
+        index_kpool: int,
+        num_q_heads: int,
+        kv_lora_rank: int,
+        qk_rope_head_dim: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Reject untuned configurations at startup, before the first batch."""
+        if architecture.split(":", 1)[0] != "gfx950":
+            raise ValueError("ROCm DSA prefill policies require gfx950")
+        if attn_tp_size != 4:
+            raise ValueError("ROCm DSA prefill policies require attention TP4")
+        if attn_cp_size != 1 or dcp_size != 1:
+            raise ValueError("ROCm DSA prefill policies do not support CP or DCP")
+        if kv_dtype != self.kv_dtype:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{self.policy_id} requires KV dtype {self.kv_dtype}; got {kv_dtype}"
+            )
+        if prefill_backend != "tilelang":
+            raise ValueError(
+                "--dsa-prefill-policy requires --dsa-prefill-backend tilelang "
+                "as its fallback"
+            )
+        if prefill_graph_enabled:
+            raise ValueError("ROCm DSA prefill policies support eager prefill only")
+        if deterministic:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "ROCm DSA prefill policies are incompatible with deterministic "
+                "inference because backend selection depends on batch shape"
+            )
+        if index_topk != 2048 or index_kpool != 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "ROCm DSA prefill policies require index_topk=2048 and index_kpool=1"
+            )
+        if (num_q_heads, kv_lora_rank, qk_rope_head_dim) != (16, 512, 64):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "ROCm DSA prefill policies require 16 local query heads, "
+                "kv_lora_rank=512 and qk_rope_head_dim=64"
+            )
+
+    def select(self, shape: DSAPrefillShape) -> RocmDSAPrefillBackend:
+        if (
+            shape.total_q_tokens == 0
+            or shape.batch_size == 0
+            or shape.total_q_tokens > 32768
+            or shape.batch_size > 8
+        ):
+            return "tilelang"
+
+        if self.kv_dtype == "bfloat16":
+            if shape.max_kv_len >= 65536:
+                min_fresh_rows = 1024
+            elif shape.max_kv_len >= 32768:
+                min_fresh_rows = 1536
+            else:
+                min_fresh_rows = 2049
+            return "aiter" if shape.total_q_tokens >= min_fresh_rows else "tilelang"
+
+        # FP8 crossover is driven by the longest fresh row, not aggregate M.
+        if shape.max_q_len >= 3072:
+            return "aiter"
+        if shape.max_kv_len >= 65536 and shape.total_q_tokens >= 1024:
+            return "aiter"
+        if shape.max_kv_len >= 8192 and shape.total_q_tokens >= 4096:
+            return "aiter"
+        if shape.max_kv_len >= 16384 and shape.max_q_len >= 2048:
+            return "aiter"
+        return "tilelang"

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""CPU coverage for bounded ROCm prefill policy and DSA integration.
+
+These tests exercise dispatch/configuration, not GPU kernel numerics or speed.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import contextlib
+import io
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsa.rocm_prefill_policy import (
+    ROCM_DSA_PREFILL_POLICIES,
+    DSAPrefillShape,
+    RocmDSAPrefillPolicy,
+)
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context, get_exec
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def shape(rows, longest=None, batch=1, kv=None):
+    return DSAPrefillShape(
+        total_q_tokens=rows,
+        max_q_len=rows if longest is None else longest,
+        batch_size=batch,
+        max_kv_len=rows if kv is None else kv,
+    )
+
+
+class TestRocmDSAPrefillPolicy(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_bf16_crossover_boundaries(self):
+        policy = RocmDSAPrefillPolicy("glm53-mi350x-tp4-bf16-v1")
+        for rows, kv, expected in (
+            (2048, 8192, "tilelang"),
+            (2049, 8192, "aiter"),
+            (1536, 32767, "tilelang"),
+            (1535, 32768, "tilelang"),
+            (1536, 32768, "aiter"),
+            (1024, 65535, "tilelang"),
+            (1023, 65536, "tilelang"),
+            (1024, 65536, "aiter"),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(rows=rows, kv=kv):
+                self.assertEqual(policy.select(shape(rows, kv=kv)), expected)
+
+    def test_fp8_uses_longest_fresh_row_not_aggregate_rows(self):
+        policy = RocmDSAPrefillPolicy("glm53-mi350x-tp4-fp8-v1")
+        for item, expected in (
+            (shape(3071), "tilelang"),
+            (shape(3072), "aiter"),

+class TestRocmDSAPrefillIntegration(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        super().setUpClass()
+        maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+        from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsa_backend import DeepseekSparseAttnBackend
+        from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+
+        cls.backend_class = DeepseekSparseAttnBackend
+        cls.forward_mode = ForwardMode
+
+    def backend(self, policy_id="glm53-mi350x-tp4-fp8-v1", use_mha=False):
+        backend = self.backend_class.__new__(self.backend_class)
+        backend.rocm_prefill_policy = (
+            None if policy_id is None else RocmDSAPrefillPolicy(policy_id)
+        )
+        backend.use_mha = use_mha
+        backend.dsa_prefill_impl = "tilelang"
+        backend.dsa_decode_impl = "tilelang"
+        return backend
+
+    def select(self, backend, lengths, kv, mode=None):
+        batch = SimpleNamespace(
+            forward_mode=self.forward_mode.EXTEND if mode is None else mode
+        )
+        return backend._select_rocm_prefill_impl(batch, lengths, kv)
+
+    def test_disabled_policy_and_dense_prefill_keep_existing_dispatch(self):
+        self.assertIsNone(self.select(self.backend(None), [8192], 8192))
+        self.assertIsNone(self.select(self.backend(use_mha=True), [8192], 8192))
+
+    def test_every_non_prefill_mode_keeps_existing_dispatch(self):
+        backend = self.backend()
+        for mode in self.forward_mode:
+            if mode != self.forward_mode.EXTEND:
+                with self.subTest(mode=mode):
+                    self.assertIsNone(self.select(backend, [8192], 131072, mode))
+
+    def test_cached_prefix_is_not_counted_as_fresh_rows(self):
+        backend = self.backend()
+        self.assertEqual(self.select(backend, [128] * 4, 131072), "tilelang")
+        self.assertEqual(self.select(backend, [256] * 4, 131072), "aiter")
+
+    def test_backend_choice_does_not_leak_into_the_next_batch(self):
+        backend = self.backend()
+        self.assertEqual(self.select(backend, [3072], 8192), "aiter")
+        self.assertEqual(self.select(backend, [128], 8192), "tilelang")
+        self.assertIsNone(self.select(backend, [1], 8192, self.forward_mode.DECODE))
+        self.assertEqual(backend.dsa_prefill_impl, "tilelang")
+        self.assertEqual(backend.dsa_decode_impl, "tilelang")
+
+    def test_layers_consume_the_stored_decision_without_reselecting(self):
+        backend = self.backend()
+        batch = SimpleNamespace(forward_mode=self.forward_mode.EXTEND)
+        backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace(selected_prefill_impl="aiter")
+        # A different layer/query shape cannot overwrite this batch's snapshot.
+        backend.rocm_prefill_policy = RocmDSAPrefillPolicy("glm53-mi350x-tp4-bf16-v1")
+        self.assertEqual(backend._get_extend_impl(batch), "aiter")
+        self.assertEqual(backend._get_extend_impl(batch), "aiter")
+        backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace(selected_prefill_impl="tilelang")
+        self.assertEqual(backend._get_extend_impl(batch), "tilelang")
+
+    def test_unselected_metadata_preserves_configured_speculative_backend(self):
+        backend = self.backend()
+        backend.dsa_decode_impl = "triton"
+        for metadata in (
+            SimpleNamespace(selected_prefill_impl=None),
+            SimpleNamespace(),
+        ):
+            backend.forward_metadata = metadata
+            for mode, expected in (
+                (self.forward_mode.EXTEND, "tilelang"),
+                (self.forward_mode.TARGET_VERIFY, "triton"),
+                (self.forward_mode.DRAFT_EXTEND_V2, "triton"),
+            ):
+                with self.subTest(mode=mode):
+                    batch = SimpleNamespace(forward_mode=mode)
+                    self.assertEqual(backend._get_extend_impl(batch), expected)
+
+    def test_stored_prefill_selection_cannot_override_other_phases(self):
+        backend = self.backend()
+        backend.dsa_decode_impl = "triton"
+        backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace(selected_prefill_impl="aiter")
+        for mode in self.forward_mode:
+            if mode == self.forward_mode.EXTEND:
+                continue
+            expected = (
+                "triton"
+                if mode.is_target_verify() or mode.is_draft_extend_v2()
+                else "tilelang"
+            )
+            with self.subTest(mode=mode):
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    backend._get_extend_impl(SimpleNamespace(forward_mode=mode)),
+                    expected,
+                )
